subject.title: claude-sonnet-5 missing from bundled Anthropic model catalog / GA-1M-context prefix list

question: Which open Sonnet 5 PR should own the catalog/context fix for this issue before it is closed?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but there are overlapping open proof-positive candidate PRs with different scope, and the issue is assigned for maintainer sequencing rather than needing another duplicate repair job.

options.title: Make the broader catalog PR canonical
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99463 as the preferred fix because it covers catalog rows, CLI catalog sizing, aliases, GA-1M lists, model-contract predicates, and tests.

options.title: Land the narrow closing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99313 if maintainers want the smallest catalog/context-window patch and will track CLI/model-contract gaps separately.

options.title: Wait for the broad rollout
options.body: Hold both narrow PRs only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98254 becomes the mergeable, proof-positive canonical Sonnet 5 rollout first.

recommendation.title: Make the broader catalog PR canonical
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99463 as the preferred fix because it covers catalog rows, CLI catalog sizing, aliases, GA-1M lists, model-contract predicates, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee on the live issue and is therefore the visible owner for the overlapping-PR sequencing choice.
